# Module `testhost`

What a page of a test program tells that program: its tests, their checks, what it measures, what it wants done to it.
For test programs only (src/tools/testhost): the global `wrenTest` that calls these exists only in a page that has been
given a test host (page.set_test_host), and without one they do nothing. A browser never gives one.

Exposed to: Window. Source: `api/testhost.widl`.

Odin: `import "wren:testhost"`.

## Types

### enum `TestSkipReason` : i32

Why something a test needs cannot run on this machine. The test host decides whether that is true.

| member | value | |
|---|---:|---|
| `WebglAdapter` | 0 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Av1Decoder` | 1 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
